---
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
    includes:
      in_header: preamble.tex
papersize: a4
geometry: "left=1.6cm,right=1.6cm,top=1.4cm,bottom=1.7cm,footskip=0.8cm"
fontsize: 10pt
params:
  app_dir: "../app"
  imports_page: false
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# PDF briefing for the Irish Trade Monitor.
#
# Render with:  Rscript scripts/render_briefing.R
# (that script finds pandoc, renders in a temporary folder and saves the PDF
# to app/www/briefing/, where the app's Briefing page links to it).
#
# All numbers, key points and chart data come from the app's own functions in
# app/R/, so this document always agrees with the Briefing page. Layout macros
# (\tmheader, \tmkpi, \tmchart, ...) are defined in preamble.tex; the static
# charts are in briefing_charts.R.
#
# params
#   app_dir       path to the app folder (holds R/ and data/).
#   imports_page  TRUE adds a third page with the same four charts for imports.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "asis")
# A terminal Rscript often runs in the C locale, where the euro sign would be
# written to the LaTeX file as "<U+20AC>". Switch to a UTF-8 locale if needed.
if (!isTRUE(l10n_info()[["UTF-8"]])) {
  for (loc in c("en_US.UTF-8", "C.UTF-8", "UTF-8")) {
    if (nzchar(suppressWarnings(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", loc)))) break
  }
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(shiny); library(bslib); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(plotly)
  library(DT); library(scales); library(arrow); library(tidyr); library(readr)
})
app_dir <- normalizePath(params$app_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
for (f in c("trade_utils.R", "analytics.R", "charts.R", "mod_briefing.R",
            "mod_structure.R", "mod_markets.R")) {
  source(file.path(app_dir, "R", f), local = knitr::knit_global())
}
source("briefing_charts.R", local = knitr::knit_global())

td <- tm_build_bundle(read_trade_data(app_dir))
met <- briefing_metrics(td)
points <- briefing_keypoints(td, met)
fam <- pdf_font_family()

# Chart sizes in cm (full text width is 17.8 cm).
FULL_W <- 17.8; FULL_H <- 9.3
HALF_W <- 8.6;  HALF_H <- 7.6

# The four detail charts for one flow, laid out two by two.
detail_page <- function(flow) {
  fname <- briefing_flow_name(flow)
  lname <- tolower(fname)
  fig <- function(plot, name) pdf_save(plot, paste0(name, "_", flow), HALF_W, HALF_H)
  ex <- if (flow == "1") "excluding aircraft and excluding chemicals & pharma"
        else "excluding pharmaceuticals and excluding chemicals & pharma"
  pdf_chart_pair(
    pdf_chart_block(
      paste0(fname, ": headline versus underlying growth"),
      paste0("3-month total vs the same 3 months a year earlier, % (total, ", ex, ")."),
      fig(pdf_chart_growth(td, flow, fam), "growth")),
    pdf_chart_block(
      paste0(fname, ": what is driving growth"),
      paste0("Contribution of each product group to 3-month y/y ", lname,
             " growth, percentage points; line = total growth, %. Last 36 months."),
      fig(pdf_chart_drivers(td, flow, fam), "drivers"))
  )
  pdf_chart_pair(
    pdf_chart_block(
      paste0(fname, ": biggest product movers"),
      briefing_movers_subtitle(td, flow, "product"),
      fig(pdf_chart_movers(td, flow, "product", fam), "products")),
    pdf_chart_block(
      paste0(fname, ": biggest market movers"),
      briefing_movers_subtitle(td, flow, "market"),
      fig(pdf_chart_movers(td, flow, "market", fam), "markets"))
  )
}
```

```{r header}
generated <- paste(as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%d")), month.name[as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%m"))],
                   format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"))
pdf_raw(
  paste0("\\renewcommand{\\tmfootnote}{", pdf_tex(paste0(
    .TM_SOURCE_NOTE, " Generated ", generated, " by the Irish Trade Monitor.")), "}"),
  paste0("\\tmheader{Irish goods trade}{Monthly briefing: ", pdf_tex(td$latest_label), "}{",
         pdf_tex(paste0(briefing_dateline(td),
                        " Text and charts are generated automatically from Eurostat Comext data.")), "}")
)
```

```{r headline-tiles}
pdf_kpi_row(pdf_briefing_tiles(met))
pdf_raw("\\vspace{5pt}", paste0("\\tmnote{", pdf_tex(paste0(
  "Headline figures are monthly values for ", td$latest_label, ", nominal EUR. y/y = on the same month a year earlier; ",
  "3m on 3m = latest three months on the previous three; 3m y/y = latest three months on the same three a year earlier. ",
  "Underlying exports exclude chemicals and pharmaceuticals.")), "}"))
```

\tmsection{Key points}

```{r key-points}
pdf_keypoints(points)
```

\tmsection{Exports and imports, last five years}

```{r trade-chart}
pdf_raw(pdf_chart_block(
  NULL,
  "Monthly values (faint lines) and 3-month averages (bold), EUR bn; grey bars show the monthly trade balance (exports minus imports).",
  pdf_save(pdf_chart_trade(td, fam), "trade", FULL_W, FULL_H)
))
```

\newpage
\tmsection{Exports in detail}

```{r exports-detail}
detail_page("2")
```

\tmsection{Concentration and exposure of exports}

```{r exposure-tiles}
pdf_kpi_row(pdf_exposure_tiles(td, "2"))
pdf_raw("\\vspace{6pt}", paste0("\\tmnote{", pdf_tex(paste0(
  "Shares are of exports over the 12 months to ", tm_fmt_month(td$latest_date),
  ". Products are 5-digit SITC. The effective number of products is 10,000 divided by the ",
  "Herfindahl-Hirschman index (HHI): exports spread evenly over that many products would be equally concentrated.")),
  "}"))
```

```{r imports-detail, eval=isTRUE(params$imports_page)}
pdf_raw("\\newpage", "\\tmsection{Imports in detail}")
detail_page("1")
```
